title: Dalagita Tomato (Known You Dalagita): Characteristics
metaDescription: Dalagita tomato is an open pollinated tomato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Dalagita tomato is an open pollinated tomato variety, also sold or known as Known You Dalagita. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Known You Seed (sold in Philippine farm shops).

heroImage.alt: Young tomato plants on silver plastic mulch beds with bamboo stakes in San Ildefonso, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Dalagita tomato is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Known You Dalagita, this is the same tomato. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [tomato variety finder](/crop-varieties/tomato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [fertilizer for tomatoes, stage by stage](/blog/fertilizer-for-tomatoes).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

blocks.text: Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Dalagita tomato

Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is Known You Dalagita the same as Dalagita?
items.a: Yes. Known You Dalagita is another name for Dalagita. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Dalagita?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
